additional_info.subject: RE: 0412248 - ID0412248-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312562229/26] The front door of the charger is cracked CRM:00641001210
additional_info.body:
Dear Thibaut,
We addressed our supplier of the housing and here is the statement:
“According to the images and only through this route, with the frontal damage/impact that the door suffered in the area of the black vinyl, it is perfectly normal for the paint to give way and "break apart". It is a polyester paint and has some elasticity, but it is not inexhaustible.
we cannot evaluate from here if there are possible damages to the welds and bends, but on the painted surface, yes, without a doubt.”
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar
